images.prompt: A moonlit cloister courtyard garden at night seen straight on, photographed at eye level: tall dark Italian cypress trees silhouetted against a deep blue night sky with scattered stars, a full moon high in the sky with a soft halo, a weathered stone fountain in the middle distance catching moonlight, pale gravel path leading away, low boxwood hedges, cool silver-blue moonlight, cinematic, photorealistic, calm, no people, no text.
